title: What's new: MCP Server (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to MCP Server and agenda
Query tools and four new system tools overview
Demo setup and data analysis capabilities
Agent workflow demonstration with customer data
Limitations and use cases for data tools
New UX for MCP configurations and server features

features.name: Find tables tool
features.description: A new system tool that enables searching for Business Central tables. Part of the data tool feature set for MCP server.
caveats: Limited to tables user has access to

features.name: Table relations tool
features.description: A system tool for understanding how tables connect to other tables in Business Central, enabling the writing of better join queries.

features.name: Table schema tool
features.description: A system tool that shows fields available on Business Central tables, allowing agents to understand table structure.

features.name: Data query tool
features.description: A system tool that enables agents to construct and run AL queries directly without needing APIs, accessing data based on user permissions.
caveats: Limited to supported AL query expressions
Subject to query runtime and data return limits

features.name: Generic data analysis for agents
features.description: Capability enabling agents to perform ad hoc analysis on Business Central data by constructing and compiling AL queries, with permissions-based access control.
caveats: Depends on user permissions and table access
Limited to what can be expressed in AL queries
Subject to query runtime and data size limits

features.name: Server features configuration UI
features.description: New user experience for MCP server configuration that distinguishes between server features such as the data tool and APIs, showing which tools each feature enables.

features.name: MCP server security toggle
features.description: A new toggle in the Copilot and Agent capabilities page to activate or deactivate the MCP server feature globally for security control.
